items.mainDefect: Non-Google createEvent implementations retain signatures that the suggestion claims do not satisfy the updated Calendar interface.

secondary.defect: Non-Google providers leave per-credential destination calendar selection unimplemented.

items.mainDefect: Office365, Lark and BaseCalendarService createEvent signatures lack the credentialId parameter required by the updated Calendar interface.

secondary.defect: These providers select the first destination calendar instead of matching the destination calendar by credentialId.

items.mainDefect: Lark createEvent lacks the credentialId parameter specified by the updated Calendar interface.

secondary.defect: Lark selects the first destination calendar without first matching by credentialId.
